phone.title: Ibipimo by'ubuzima bivuye muri telefoni
phone.intro: Rinda ishobora gusoma amakuru y'ubuzima telefoni yawe isanzwe ibika muri Apple Health cyangwa Health Connect, nk'umutima utera, intambwe, ibitotsi, umuvuduko w'amaraso n'ibiro. Hoherezwa incamake imwe gusa ku munsi, kandi ushobora guhagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
phone.share: Sangiza Rinda ibipimo by'ubuzima biri muri telefoni yanjye
phone.onlyApp: Ibi bikora muri porogaramu ya Rinda kuri telefoni, aho telefoni yawe yemerera Rinda gusoma amakuru y'ubuzima.
phone.failed: Rinda ntiyashoboye gusoma amakuru y'ubuzima ya telefoni yawe. Reba ko Health Connect (Android) cyangwa Apple Health (iPhone) yemerera Rinda kuyasoma.
phone.iosNote: Kuri iPhone, Apple ntibwira porogaramu ibipimo wemeye, bityo igipimo kibura gishobora kuba kitarasangijwe.
phone.off: Ibipimo by'ubuzima bivuye muri telefoni ntibirafungurwa.
phone.filled: Byuzujwe uhereye kuri telefoni yawe. Reba imibare mbere yo gukomeza.
phone.noRecent: Nta bipimo bya vuba biri muri telefoni yawe.

sms.title: Ubutumwa bugufi (SMS)
sms.body: Akira ubutumwa bugufi nyuma ya buri suzuma burimo ibisubizo n'imibare yawe, inama n'umurongo wa raporo yose. Ibisubizo by'imitekerereze n'umunaniro ntibijya byoherezwa. Umuntu wese ushobora gufungura telefoni yawe ashobora kubusoma.
sms.toggle: Nyoherereza incamake z'isuzuma ryanjye kuri SMS
sms.needPhone: Shyiramo nimero ya telefoni yawe muri "Amakuru yanjye" hejuru kugira ngo ububone.
sms.unavailable: Kohereza byahagaze by’agateganyo. Icyo wahisemo kirabitswe kandi kizakoreshwa nibyongera gutangira.

delivery.title: Twakoherereza dute ibisubizo by'isuzuma ryawe?
delivery.body: Nyuma ya buri suzuma, Rinda ishobora kukoherereza incamake. Hitamo ikikunogeye. Ushobora kubihindura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose mu Mwirondoro wawe.
delivery.failed: Ibyo wahisemo ntibyashoboye kubikwa. Ongera ugerageze.
delivery.needEmail: Andika aderesi ya imeri yawe kugira ngo ubone imeri.
delivery.needPhone: Andika nimero ya telefoni yawe kugira ngo ubone ubutumwa bugufi.

profile.title: Umwirondoro
profile.passwordChanged: Ijambo ry'ibanga ryahinduwe. Izindi telefoni na mudasobwa byasohowe.
profile.aboutHint: Bifasha porogaramu gusobanura bimwe mu bisubizo. Ushobora kubireka uko biri.
profile.deleteTitle: Kuva mu bushakashatsi no gusiba amakuru yanjye
profile.deleteBody: Ushobora kuva mu bushakashatsi igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Tuzasiba amasuzuma yawe n'amakuru yawe mu masaha 72.
profile.deleteConfirm: Urashaka ko dusiba amakuru yawe? Nimara gusibwa ntibishobora gusubizwaho.
profile.consentsBody: Hindura ibi byemezo igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Buri gihinduka kibikwa nk'inyandiko nshya. Kugira ngo uve mu bushakashatsi burundu, saba ko amakuru yawe asibwa hepfo.

emailReports.title: Raporo kuri imeri
emailReports.body: Akira incamake ya buri suzuma kuri imeri: ibisubizo n'imibare yawe, inama na gahunda y'icyumweru. Ibisubizo by'imitekerereze n'umunaniro ntibijya byoherezwa. Umuntu wese ushobora gufungura imeri yawe ashobora kuyisoma.
emailReports.toggle: Nyoherereza incamake z'isuzuma ryanjye kuri imeri
emailReports.needEmail: Shyiramo aderesi ya imeri yawe muri "Amakuru yanjye" hejuru kugira ngo uzibone.
emailReports.unavailable: Kohereza byahagaze by’agateganyo. Icyo wahisemo kirabitswe kandi kizakoreshwa nibyongera gutangira.
emailReports.sendFailed: Imeri ntiyashoboye koherezwa. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.

aiOptIn.title: Ibisobanuro bya AI
aiOptIn.body: Emerera serivisi ya AI gusubiramo mu yandi magambo ibisobanuro byemejwe by'ibisubizo byawe. Yakira gusa amagambo n'imibare by'ibisubizo byawe, ntijya yakira izina ryawe, aho twakubona cyangwa ibisubizo by'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe. Ushobora kubihagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
aiOptIn.unavailable: Ibisobanuro bya AI ntibiratangira gukora. Uzakomeza kubona ibisobanuro byemejwe.
